claim_text: ClinicalBench uses BCa bootstrap 95% CIs, n=2000 resamples, seed 42, with patient-level cluster bootstrap over 43 patients. Any reported CI must use the full declared resample set; a bootstrap resample subset is a selective-aggregation violation.

predicates.natural_language: The bootstrap CI must use all declared resamples (n=2000, seed 42); no resample subset may be selectively used.
